column1: # Indo-European reconstructions as the Leiden series and Wiktionary write them: the notation
# de Vaan (2008) in LiLa and Wiktionary's PIE and Proto-Italic share. A source's profile
# includes it and adds its own rows.

column4: labialization: kʷ and ku̯ fold together
non-syllabic u: w, u̯ and u fold together
non-syllabic i: y, j, i̯ and i fold together
acute: accent (the palatals ḱ ǵ have rows of their own)
macron: length, compared only when both forms mark length somewhere
inverted breve above (the palatals k̑ g̑ have rows of their own)
non-syllabic i written j (de Vaan; Wiktionary in Proto-Italic)
palatal: ḱ and k are not folded
palatal: ǵ and g are not folded
